HEADING: Connected Apps
INTRO: Applications you have authorized to use the FastComments API on behalf of this account, such as AI assistants connected through the MCP server. Revoking an app invalidates every token it holds.
EMPTY_BODY: When you authorize an application, such as Claude or Cursor through the MCP server, it appears here.
REVOKE_CONFIRM: Revoke this application's access? It will have to be authorized again to reconnect.
REVOKED_FLASH: Access revoked. Tokens held by that application stop working within a minute.
UNVERIFIED_APP_NOTE: Applications register themselves when they connect. FastComments does not review them, so revoke anything you do not recognize.
